A.repro: Every figure is labelled a memory estimate. This is honest but cannot be reproduced.
A.refs: Papers are named only, with no identifiers or quotes, so none can be resolved.
A.accuracy: Ra et al. 2018 is misplaced as Hong Kong-based (it was a Los Angeles cohort). The other recollections are hedged as estimates.
A.limits: States specific limits: knowledge cutoff, the unmeasured gap to today, no lanes, and what it cannot answer. Nothing was measured to bound.
A.verdict: Gives a rewrite, a decision, a reasoned confidence and what would change it. Names sibling and Mendelian-randomization attenuation as contrary evidence.
A.facets: All facets are answered from memory, with no grounded values.

B.refs: No research documents. Only tool calls are cited.
B.accuracy: The c1 values are read correctly, including the subject-lane caveat on the 428 supporting documents. But c2 returned ok:false with null data, and B attributes an invented quote and no_data payload to it. The chart window is also invented.

B.facets: Covers the rewrite, a grounded corpus mix with caveat, the strongest document (an honest 'none'), and what the evidence tier allows the verb to be.

B: Quote and no_data payload attributed to c2, but c2 returned ok:false with null data
Chart window 2026-10-23 to 2026-10-23 invented; the record window was empty

raw.verdict: All four correctly downgrade 'causes' to an associational verb. B best tied its rewrite, the corpus mix and the subject-lane caveat to the recorded call, and gave a calibrated low confidence. B and C both lose points for quoting text from a c2 call that actually returned null. D's polished citations rest on an unresolvable DOI, and A is an honest memory answer with one factual slip.
